arguments.value: This agreement is an outsourcing contract under which Virtual Item Processing Systems (VIP) provides electronic data processing services to Brokers National Life Assurance Company (BNL) for insurance policy administration. BNL must supply and maintain compatible equipment and pay VIP’s monthly processing fees and any additional charges for extra lines, devices, special services, and related expenses. VIP is responsible for maintaining the system, backing up data, providing a backup facility if there is a major outage, and keeping BNL’s data confidential. BNL owns its own data, while VIP owns the system and software; BNL gets only a limited license to use it during the contract term. The agreement sets out service levels, security, indemnity, warranties, liability limits, termination rights, a one-year initial term with automatic one-year renewals unless notice is given, and arbitration in the event of disputes.
